svg.title: Blue Green Yellow Orange Red
svg.desc: Hand-authored interpretive SVG after direct visual inspection of the cited primary reference. Approximate contours and standardized vivid colors; paint texture, photographic perspective and external framing omitted. Only an oblique1996 catalogue photograph is available. Five colored joined panels and visible sequence are observed; perspective taper is not asserted to be actual support geometry. Excluded from physical-size view.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://archive.org/download/ellswo00kell/ellswo00kell.pdf#page=58; record guggenheim1996-essay-58-fig-19; visual review 2026-10-27. Pure-vector study; not a facsimile.
